AIVerificationCreate.title: AIVerificationCreate
AIVerificationCreate.description:
Payload used by the AI/OCR pipeline to record a verification
result against a document.

ApplicationCreate.title: ApplicationCreate
ApplicationCreate.description:
Payload for `POST /applications`. `application_number` is
generated server-side, so it is intentionally excluded here.

AuditLogCreate.title: AuditLogCreate
AuditLogCreate.description:
Payload used internally by the service layer / middleware when
recording an action. `institution_id` may be omitted; the DB
trigger fills it in from `user_id` when absent.

ChatHistoryCreate.title: ChatHistoryCreate
ChatHistoryCreate.description:
Payload for `POST /chat` — the student asks a question. The
`response` is filled in by the AI integration layer, not the
client.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Payload for `POST /auth/login`.

`institution_code` disambiguates which tenant to authenticate
against when the same email is reused across institutions (see
the partial-unique-index design on `users.email`). Omit it only
when authenticating a platform-level Super Admin.

NotificationUpdate.title: NotificationUpdate
NotificationUpdate.description:
Payload for `PATCH /notifications/{notification_id}` — in
practice used only to mark a notification as read.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description:
Payload for `POST /users`. `password` is hashed by the service
layer before persistence — never store or accept `password_hash`
directly from a client.
